$comment: Annex C — Public action catalog (use:). Generated from language-surface PUBLIC_ACTIONS + action_manifest::PUBLIC_ACTION_NAMES.

actions.name: anchor
actions.summary: Position a popper-like surface against an anchor element.

actions.name: autosize
actions.summary: Autosize a textarea (height) or single-line input (width) to its content.

actions.name: clickOutside
actions.summary: Fire a callback when a click lands outside the element.

actions.name: clipboard
actions.summary: Copy param text (or host text content) to the clipboard on click; optional onCopy success callback.

actions.name: contextMenu
actions.summary: Right-click menu: open on contextmenu, close on outside-click / ESC.

actions.name: dropzone
actions.summary: Drag-and-drop file receiver; reads files into a controller-side handler.

actions.name: hotkeys
actions.summary: Declarative key→handler map on the document; ignores editable fields unless allowInInputs.

actions.name: rect
actions.summary: Track the element's bounding rect via ResizeObserver.

actions.name: tipDescribe
actions.summary: Hover/focus-triggered tooltip; open on pointer-in, close on pointer-out with delay.

actions.name: virtualRow
actions.summary: Register a virtualized row; tells the parent scroller its measured height.

actions.name: zoomPan
actions.summary: Pinch/wheel zoom + drag pan on a surface; emits state changes to the controller.

note: Widget-private actions remain auto-imported for stdlib stamps but are not public / taught.
